segments.sn3.25:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.sn3.25:1.3: “handa, kuto nu tvaṃ, mahārāja, āgacchasi divā divassā”ti?
segments.sn3.25:1.4: “Yāni tāni, bhante, raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddhāvasittānaṃ issariyamadamattānaṃ kāmagedhapariyuṭṭhitānaṃ janapadatthāvariyappattānaṃ mahantaṃ pathavimaṇḍalaṃ abhivijiya ajjhāvasantānaṃ rājakaraṇīyāni bhavanti, tesu khvāhaṃ, etarahi ussukkamāpanno”ti.
segments.sn3.25:2.2: idha te puriso āgaccheyya puratthimāya disāya saddhāyiko paccayiko.
segments.sn3.25:2.4: ‘yagghe, mahārāja, jāneyyāsi, ahaṃ āgacchāmi puratthimāya disāya.
segments.sn3.25:2.5: Tatthaddasaṃ mahantaṃ pabbataṃ abbhasamaṃ sabbe pāṇe nippothento āgacchati.
segments.sn3.25:2.6: Yaṃ te, mahārāja, karaṇīyaṃ, taṃ karohī’ti.
segments.sn3.25:2.7: Atha dutiyo puriso āgaccheyya pacchimāya disāya … pe …
segments.sn3.25:2.8: atha tatiyo puriso āgaccheyya uttarāya disāya … pe …
segments.sn3.25:2.9: atha catuttho puriso āgaccheyya dakkhiṇāya disāya saddhāyiko paccayiko.
segments.sn3.25:2.11: ‘yagghe mahārāja, jāneyyāsi, ahaṃ āgacchāmi dakkhiṇāya disāya.
segments.sn3.25:2.12: Tatthaddasaṃ mahantaṃ pabbataṃ abbhasamaṃ sabbe pāṇe nippothento āgacchati.
segments.sn3.25:2.13: Yaṃ te, mahārāja, karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohī’ti.
segments.sn3.25:2.14: Evarūpe te, mahārāja, mahati mahabbhaye samuppanne dāruṇe manussakkhaye [manussakāye (ka.)] dullabhe manussatte kimassa karaṇīyan”ti?
segments.sn3.25:3.1: “Evarūpe me, bhante, mahati mahabbhaye samuppanne dāruṇe manussakkhaye dullabhe manussatte kimassa karaṇīyaṃ aññatra dhammacariyāya aññatra samacariyāya aññatra kusalakiriyāya aññatra puññakiriyāyā”ti?
segments.sn3.25:4.1: “Ārocemi kho te, mahārāja, paṭivedemi kho te, mahārāja, adhivattati kho taṃ, mahārāja, jarāmaraṇaṃ.
segments.sn3.25:4.2: Adhivattamāne ce te, mahārāja, jarāmaraṇe kimassa karaṇīyan”ti?
segments.sn3.25:4.3: “Adhivattamāne ca me, bhante, jarāmaraṇe kimassa karaṇīyaṃ aññatra dhammacariyāya samacariyāya kusalakiriyāya puññakiriyāya?
segments.sn3.25:4.4: Yāni tāni, bhante, raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddhāvasittānaṃ issariyamadamattānaṃ kāmagedhapariyuṭṭhitānaṃ janapadatthāvariyappattānaṃ mahantaṃ pathavimaṇḍalaṃ abhivijiya ajjhāvasantānaṃ hatthiyuddhāni bhavanti;
segments.sn3.25:4.5: tesampi, bhante, hatthiyuddhānaṃ natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.
segments.sn3.25:4.6: Yānipi tāni, bhante, raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddhāvasittānaṃ … pe …
segments.sn3.25:4.10: tesampi, bhante, pattiyuddhānaṃ natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.
segments.sn3.25:4.11: Santi kho pana, bhante, imasmiṃ rājakule mantino mahāmattā, ye pahonti [yesaṃ honti (ka.)] āgate paccatthike mantehi bhedayituṃ.
segments.sn3.25:4.12: Tesampi, bhante, mantayuddhānaṃ natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.
segments.sn3.25:4.13: Saṃvijjati kho pana, bhante, imasmiṃ rājakule pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ bhūmigatañceva vehāsaṭṭhañca, yena mayaṃ pahoma āgate paccatthike dhanena upalāpetuṃ.
segments.sn3.25:4.14: Tesampi, bhante, dhanayuddhānaṃ natthi gati natthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.
segments.sn3.25:4.15: Adhivattamāne ca me, bhante, jarāmaraṇe kimassa karaṇīyaṃ aññatra dhammacariyāya samacariyāya kusalakiriyāya puññakiriyāyā”ti?
segments.sn3.25:5.2: Adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe kimassa karaṇīyaṃ aññatra dhammacariyāya samacariyāya kusalakiriyāya puññakiriyāyā”ti?
segments.sn3.25:10.1: “Yo dhammaṃ cari [dhammacārī (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] kāyena,

lines: Esa kira rājā divasassa tikkhattuṃ bhagavato upaṭṭhānaṃ gacchati, antarāgamanāni bahūnipi honti.
Tassa nibaddhaṃ gacchato balakāyo mahāpi hoti appopi.
“ayaṃ rājā avelāya appena balena samaṇassa gotamassa upaṭṭhānaṃ gacchati, antarāmagge naṃ gahetvā rajjaṃ gaṇhissāmā”ti.
Atha tesaṃyeva abbhantarato eko puriso nikkhamitvā rañño ārocesi.

Rājā mahantaṃ balakāyaṃ ādāya andhavanaṃ parivāretvā te sabbe gahetvā andhavanato yāva nagaradvārā maggassa ubhosu passesu yathā aññamaññaṃ cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanibandhitvā olokenti, evaṃ āsannāni sūlāni ropāpetvā sūlesu uttāsesi.

“sacāhaṃ vakkhāmi,‘mahārāja, mādise nāma sammāsambuddhe dhuravihāre vasante tayā evarūpaṃ dāruṇaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ, ayuttaṃ te katan’ti, athāyaṃ rājā maṅku hutvā santhambhituṃ na sakkuṇeyya, pariyāyena dhammaṃ kathentasseva me sallakkhessatī”ti dhammadesanaṃ ārabhanto taṃ kiṃ maññasītiādimāha.
Tattha saddhāyikoti saddhātabbo, yassa tvaṃ vacanaṃ saddahasīti attho.
Paccayikoti tasseva vevacanaṃ, yassa vacanaṃ pattiyāyasīti attho.
Nippothento āgacchatīti pathavitalato yāva akaniṭṭhabrahmalokā sabbe satte saṇhakaraṇīyaṃ tiṇacuṇṇaṃ viya karonto pisanto āgacchati.
Aññatra dhammacariyāyāti ṭhapetvā dhammacariyaṃ aññaṃ kātabbaṃ natthi, dasakusalakammapathasaṅkhātā dhammacariyāva kattabbā, bhanteti – samacariyā dīni tasseva vevacanāni.
Na hi sakkā tehi jarāmaraṇaṃ paṭibāhituṃ.
Vehāsaṭṭhanti cammapasibbake pūretvā tulāsaṅghāṭādīsu laggetvā ceva niyyuhādīsu ca pūretvā ṭhapitaṃ.
Yathā dve janā ekena maggena na gacchanti evaṃ kātuṃ.
Evaṃ jarā ca maccu cāti idha dveyeva pabbatā gahitā, rājovāde pana “jarā āgacchati sabbayobbanaṃ vilumpamānā”ti evaṃ jarā maraṇaṃ byādhi vipattīti cattāropete āgatāva.
Tasmāti yasmā hatthiyuddhādīhi jarāmaraṇaṃ jinituṃ na sakkā, tasmā.
Pathavimaṇḍalassa mahantatā taṃnivāsinaṃ anuyantatāti sabbamidaṃ yathicchitassa rājakiccassa sukhena samijjhanassa kāraṇakittanaṃ.
Yādise rājakicce ussukkaṃ āpanno, taṃ vitthārato dassetuṃ “esa kirā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Corā cintayiṃsūti eko antarabhogiko rājāparādhiko pañcasatamanussaparivāro coriyaṃ karonto vicarati, te sandhāya vuttaṃ.
Dhuravihāreti rathassa dhuraṃ viya nagarassa dhurabhūte vihāre.
Dhammacariyātiādittampi sīsaṃ celañca ajjhupekkhitvā sammāpaṭipatti eva kātabbā tassā eva paraloke patiṭṭhābhāvato.
Ācikkhāmīti kathemi, kathento ca yathā tamatthaṃ sammadeva rājā jānāti, evaṃ jānāpemīti.
Visinoti bandhati yathādhippetaṃ cittaṃ etenāti visayo, samatthabhāvo.

after.title: Pabbatūpamasuttavaṇṇanā
lines: Hatthiyuddhādīhi jarāmaraṇaṃ jinituṃ na sakkā sattassa avisayabhāvato.
Yena pana jinituṃ sakkā, taṃ dassento bhagavā “buddhe … pe … nivesaye”ti āha.
Ratanattaye hi saddhā niviṭṭhā mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā ekantato jarāmaraṇavijayāya hoti.
